edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, Deutsche Welle reported “This summer was the third-warmest on record on the European continent and the hottest on record in Western Europe.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “It was the continent's third warmest summer on record and the hottest for western Europe, with several countries reporting all-time temperature highs.”.

On 2026-10-02, Deutsche Welle reported “This summer was the third-warmest on record on the European continent and the hottest on record in Western Europe.”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “milder but still deadly heat across the rest of the continent made the summer Europe’s third hottest on record.”.

On 2026-10-02, The Guardian reported “milder but still deadly heat across the rest of the continent made the summer Europe’s third hottest on record.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “It was the continent's third warmest summer on record and the hottest for western Europe, with several countries reporting all-time temperature highs.”.

On 2026-10-02, Deutsche Welle reported “A record 52% of Europe witnessed "very strong" heat stress by the end of this summer, the EU's Copernicus Climate Service (C3S) said in new research published on Friday.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “This left 52 percent of Europe exposed to "very strong" heat stress -- when temperatures feel hotter than 38C -- according to Copernicus.”.

On 2026-10-02, Deutsche Welle reported “According to Copernicus, "very strong" heat stress is characterized by temperatures which feel higher than 38 degrees Celsius (100.4 degrees Fahrenheit).”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “more than half the continent seared by “very strong” heat stress that felt hotter than 38C.”.

On 2026-10-02, Deutsche Welle reported “Around 80% of Europe witnessed "strong" heat stress by the end of the summer.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “Around 80 percent of the continent experienced "strong" heat stress, or feels-like temperatures of more than 32C, which occurred on a record 41 days by the end of the season.”.
